notes: Fixes from your 0.7.0 video: the app drawer's right rail is now one tick per letter (no more overlapping letters and dots); Phone wallpaper actually takes effect - the system wallpaper (static or live) now shows through the window, Kinto wallpaper still works as before; the Lens no longer appears over Settings after setup and sits out any full-screen surface; setup choices now visibly show what's selected (ember highlight + checkmark + a Selected line); and the setup order is fixed - Allow restricted settings now comes before Enable Kinto Assist, so Android no longer denies it on the first try. Setup is now 9 steps.
